positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software to control emissions testing hardware at the Chrysler Proving Grounds. Applications include hardware that collects and analyzes emissions and analyzes particulates in exhaust flow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed C++ software and firmware for Industrial and Automotive Applications. Performed software unit and integration testing of applications developed.

positions.title: Research Engineer & Preliminary Design Analyst
positions.description:
Led design and development of large scale system and optimization application.
 Designed application architecture and Graphical User Interface (GUI)
 Developed 3D Graphics visualization libraries utilizing NURBS surfaces
 Design application is 550,000+ lines of C++ code

Developed expertise in: Algorithms, Multi-Agent Systems, Fuzzy Logic and Optimization, preliminary design and general arrangements theory, Computer 3D Graphics (OpenGL), Parallel Programming (OpenMP), Object Oriented Programming

positions.title: Graduate Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Continued to broaden technical skill set while advancing the development of an extensive general arrangements optimization application.

positions.title: Senior Research Engineer
positions.description:
Team member in Advanced Technology Division responsible for naval combat systems related analysis and tool development.

Project Management
Managed survivability analysis for the Korean LP(X) ship programs.  Developed new modeling and simulation analytical tools for Alion and the US Navy.

Task Management
Performed Survivability Analysis on DDG 1000 and LCS ship programs. Performed Infrared Signatures on Israeli Modified Corvette, and LCS ship programs.

Technical Development
Developed technical expertise in the areas of discrete event and continuous simulation, infrared signatures, vulnerability, recoverability, design optimization, naval architecture, and total ship systems integration.
